title: [Ruling] After an authorized approval, the owning seat lands a governed PR — later pushes need no second word from the maintainer (maintainer, 2026-09-13, option C)
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat (session `session_01DAcomhvR9kKizeYgg89Vo8`, GitHub `os-project-manager`) to carry a maintainer ruling given in live chat, 2026-09-13T08:4xZ. ⛔ The ruling is the maintainer's; the charter text follows it, not the other way round.

## The question, as put to the maintainer (verbatim, the seat's options)

Trigger: PR #17914 (spec lane, governed `skills/**`) was approved by os-zhuang at 2026-09-13T06:21Z on `8aa2f28a`, ejected from the merge queue at 06:44Z (a red queue build), then carried a merge of `main` and two regenerated ledgers to `c7ae2c10` — governed bytes byte-identical to the approved commit — and the spec seat handed it back to the maintainer for a second click, because AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 reads 「no AI seat merges, queues, or arms auto-merge on a PR whose diff touches one」. The maintainer asked: 「17914 这种我已经批准过了，再修改应该不需要我批准，这种能处理吗？和我讨论」.

The seat's options, verbatim:

> - **A. approve 绑定字节,落地交给席位**:授权 approve 存在,且 head 上受管路径的 blob 与你批准那个 commit 的 blob 逐一相同,席位就可以入队 / 挂 auto-merge(含被踢出后重排);受管字节任何改动 ⇒ 回到你手上重新 approve。
> - **B. 维持现状**:每次踢出/变基都多你一次点击。
> - **C. approve 后不管后续改动**都由席位落地:不建议,这正是今早你说 skills 要你确认的那条线。

## The ruling (maintainer, verbatim)

> C. approve 后不管后续改动都由席位落地:

The seat had recommended A and named C as the line drawn earlier the same morning; the maintainer chose C with that concern in front of them. C is the ruling.

## What C means operationally (existing rules that still hold, ⛔ not new ones)

1. The approval must be an authorized approver's APPROVED review (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`: os-zhuang, hotlong); a DISMISSED or superseded approval never counts (the queue guard's ruled predicate since #8161 is unchanged: an authorized APPROVED on ANY commit).
2. After that approval, the seat that owns the PR lands it: pre-landing check on the CURRENT head — its own contract-review record naming that head, `check-clause2-carriers --pair N` exit 0, all checks green (a base-inherited red judged by the #17934 shape), then ready + auto-merge / queue. Ejections and rebases are re-queued by the seat, not the maintainer.
3. The maintainer's word is spent once per governed PR — the approval. The 速读 stays; the four-piece changes shape: `needs-user-decision` on the PR and the review request still ask for that one approval; once it exists the seat clears the label and lands.
4. Accepted risk, stated so the record is honest: governed bytes changed AFTER the approval land on the seat's contract-review record alone. The maintainer chose this over the byte-pinned variant (A).

## Text to land (charter, governed — one hand merge; rides the charter-revision PR, chain head #17942, since `SKILL.md` is occupied by PR #17957 until it lands)

- `AGENTS.md` Prime Directive #14: the sentence 「no AI seat merges, queues, or arms auto-merge on a PR whose diff touches one」 becomes: the maintainer confirms a governed surface by an authorized approval; before that approval no AI seat merges, queues or arms auto-merge; after it the owning seat lands the PR, later pushes included.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` red line :27 「⛔ 受管面 PR 无授权批准时永不翻 ready、永不入队、永不挂 auto-merge。」 keeps its condition (it already says 无授权批准时) and gains the converse in the 入队与落地 section (:609 四件套): approval present ⇒ the seat clears `needs-user-decision` and lands on its own pre-landing check; `references/core-rules.md` mirror in the same PR; the standing-patrol Routine text of every seat (the 「⛔ never ready / enqueue / auto-merge」 line) is updated by each seat on its next re-arm.
- Queue guards (`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, objectui `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`): no change — their predicate already accepts the approval on any commit.

## Immediate effect

Effective on this record (维护者裁决 > text). #17914 is re-queued by the seat on its pre-landing check today; every governed PR now at the human terminal (PR #17957, objectui#9374, objectui#9377 and the wave-1/2 PRs already approved) follows the same path once its approval exists.
